item.title: Homepage
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Capturing life

ONE SECOND
at a TIME

Experience time like never before, with each second revealing a new chapter in the story of precision, craftsmanship, and elegance.

Shop now
Discover

Our COLLECTIONS

Velocità Collection

Velocità

Inspired by the speed and precision of time, this collection embodies the swift elegance of modern watchmaking.

Shop the watches ChronoCraft Collection

ChronoCraft

A collection that highlights the craftsmanship and engineering marvel behind each second's movement.

Shop the watches Precision Collection

Precision

A series that celebrates the flawless accuracy and timeless elegance of classic timepieces.

Shop the watches
Explore

Our MODELS

  • Velocità Aero

    Automatic, Ø 41mm, Black

    $250.00 View cart

  • Velocità Corsa

    Quartz Chronograph, Ø 44mm, Leather

    $430.00 View cart

  • Velocità Strada

    Automatic, Ø 42mm, Black

    $360.00 View cart

CRAFTED for
THOSE who VALUE
every MOMENT

At Orologio, we believe that time is the most valuable resource, one that should be celebrated with every passing second. Our theme captures the essence of luxury and precision, giving you a front-row seat to the art of time.

Read more

“A watch is more than just a tool to measure time; it's a canvas where every second is an opportunity to create art”

Fabio Orologio
Capturing moments

ONE SECOND
at a TIME

est. 1968 luxury & precision art of time

.orologio

At Orologio, we believe that time is the most valuable resource, one that should be celebrated with every passing second. Our theme captures the essence of luxury and precision, giving you a front-row seat to the art of time.

About the brand
Our latest model

Eclipse
Vanguard

A bold design with shadowy tones and
cutting-edge features

Discover now Have Questions? We're Here to Help You Find Your Perfect Timepiece

Join the
MOVEMENT

Follow us on social media and share your moments with #OrologioMovement and let’s capture every second, together.

  • Instagram
  • Tiktok
https://orologio.okthemes.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/homepage_video_social.mp4
Our

Craftmanship

At Orologio, every watch is a testament to the art of precision. Our master artisans combine traditional techniques with modern innovation to create timepieces that embody elegance and durability. Each detail is meticulously crafted, ensuring that every second is a masterpiece.

Savoir-faire
Our

Heritage

Orologio’s legacy is built on a deep respect for the art of watchmaking. With roots tracing back to the traditions of Swiss horology, we blend timeless craftsmanship with modern innovation. Each timepiece reflects our commitment to preserving the past while shaping the future of luxury watches.

Our history

item.content:encoded:
About

Maison Orologio

“A watch is more than just a tool to measure time; it's a canvas where every second is an opportunity to create art”

Fabio Orologio

At Orologio, we believe that time is the most valuable resource, one that should be celebrated with every passing second. Our theme captures the essence of luxury and precision, giving you a front-row seat to the art of time.

Orologio gives you a front-row seat to the art of time — a place where function meets finesse and every moment is worth highlighting.

 

OROLOGIO
embodies the BALANCE of
BEAUTY & FUNCTION

More than

100 years of
EXCELLENCE

For over a century, Orologio has been at the forefront of luxury watchmaking, crafting timepieces that embody precision, elegance, and innovation. Our commitment to excellence has defined every generation, making each watch not just a keeper of time, but a symbol of enduring quality and timeless design.

History
Our

PHILOSOPHY

At Orologio, we believe time is more than something to be measured—it’s something to be cherished. Our philosophy is rooted in the pursuit of perfection, where every detail matters. We blend innovation with tradition to create timepieces that not only tell time but also tell a story. Time is an art, and we are its craftsmen.

Our philosophy
Where

Precision meets
ARTISTRY

At Orologio, every second is a masterpiece. We combine the exacting precision of Swiss engineering with the beauty of fine craftsmanship to create watches that are both functional and artful. It’s an art form.

Technical
MASTERY

Bespoke
TIMEPIECES

Artistic
SIGNATURES

item.title: History
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
About

Our History

“Designing a watch is like sculpting time itself— every detail must honor both the fleeting and the eternal. ”

Founder & Watchmaker

 

At Orologio, we believe that time is the most valuable resource, one that should be celebrated with every passing second. Our theme captures the essence of luxury and precision giving you a front-row seat to the art of time.

Scroll to timeline
The

FAMILY

Three GENERATIONS of
WATCHMAKERS

Timeline

TIME from 1839

Inspired by the speed and precision of time, this collection embodies the swift elegance of modern watchmaking.

1839 1839

Birth of Precision

In 1839, the company was founded by master watchmaker Émile Dubois in Geneva, Switzerland. With a small workshop and a passion for mechanical innovation, Dubois set out to create timepieces that combined precision with elegance.

1850 1850

First Breakthrough

The release of the company’s first pocket watch, the Dubois 1, marked a significant moment. Known for its accuracy and intricate design, it gained popularity among aristocrats and travelers across Europe.

1900 1900

Industrial Age

Adapting to the industrial era, the company introduced semi-mechanized production techniques without compromising on quality. This shift allowed for greater consistency and output, making watches more accessible.

2000 2000

A New Generation

Émile Dubois passed the leadership to his son, Henri Dubois, a visionary who began exploring wristwatches and international partnerships. This transition marked the beginning of a new chapter rooted in legacy and innovation.

Where we are

Today
ARTISTRY

item.title: Founders
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
About

Legendary Founders

EXCEPTIONAL men
the FOUNDERS of
maison OROLOGIO

In a world shaped by fleeting trends and momentary brilliance, there stand a few who defy convention—exceptional men whose vision transcends time.

 These pioneers are not just artisans; they are architects of legacy, driven by a relentless pursuit of perfection. From the intricate movements of a timepiece to the silent language of design, their dedication to craft is evident in every detail they shape.

 

At maison OROLOGIO, tradition meets transformation. The legacy continues, not just in watches but in the lives they touch and the stories they inspire. These are not simply instruments of time—they are emblems of character, designed by the exceptional, for the extraordinary.

Fabio Orologio

Founder

Mateo Orologio

Director of the company

Mark Orologio

Watchmaker

More than

100 years of
EXCELLENCE

For over a century, Orologio has been at the forefront of luxury watchmaking, crafting timepieces that embody precision, elegance, and innovation. Our commitment to excellence has defined every generation, making each watch not just a keeper of time, but a symbol of enduring quality and timeless design.

History
Our

PHILOSOPHY

At Orologio, we believe time is more than something to be measured—it’s something to be cherished. Our philosophy is rooted in the pursuit of perfection, where every detail matters. We blend innovation with tradition to create timepieces that not only tell time but also tell a story. Time is an art, and we are its craftsmen.

Our philosophy

item.title: Savoire-Faire
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Discover

our Savoir-Faire

Only

Quality
MATERIALS

Each piece is a seamless blend of technical perfection and timeless design, where precision is not just a feature — it’s an art form.

At the heart of every timepiece lies an unwavering commitment to craftsmanship, heritage, and precision. Our legacy is built on generations of horological excellence, where every watch is more than a tool—it's a testament to enduring elegance and technical mastery.

From the delicate assembly of micro-components to the final polish of each case, our artisans blend traditional techniques with modern innovation. Each movement is hand-calibrated for precision. Each dial, a canvas of artistry.

Complex

Watch
COMPLICATIONS

Essential Functions

Perpetual
Chronograph

A chronograph is a stopwatch built into the watch. Often used in sports or aviation, it allows the wearer to time events with precision. Most chronographs feature sub-dials for tracking seconds, minutes, and even hours.

Moon Indicators

Celestial
Moonphase

The moonphase complication displays the current phase of the moon as seen from Earth. It’s a poetic feature that blends astronomy and artistry, often showcased on a delicately designed sub-dial.

Travel & Time Zones

Time
GMT & Dual

GMT (Greenwich Mean Time) complications allow the wearer to track a second time zone—ideal for frequent travelers. This function is typically shown with an additional hand or sub-dial and is a favorite among pilots and globe-trotters.

Calendar Intelligence

Perpetual
Calendar

This advanced complication automatically adjusts for months of different lengths and even leap years. A mechanical marvel, the perpetual calendar can keep perfect date information for decades without manual correction.

Essential Functions

Perpetual
Chronograph

A chronograph is a stopwatch built into the watch. Often used in sports or aviation, it allows the wearer to time events with precision. Most chronographs feature sub-dials for tracking seconds, minutes, and even hours.

Moon Indicators

Celestial
Moonphase

The moonphase complication displays the current phase of the moon as seen from Earth. It’s a poetic feature that blends astronomy and artistry, often showcased on a delicately designed sub-dial.

Travel & Time Zones

Time
GMT & Dual

GMT (Greenwich Mean Time) complications allow the wearer to track a second time zone—ideal for frequent travelers. This function is typically shown with an additional hand or sub-dial and is a favorite among pilots and globe-trotters.

Calendar Intelligence

Perpetual
Calendar

This advanced complication automatically adjusts for months of different lengths and even leap years. A mechanical marvel, the perpetual calendar can keep perfect date information for decades without manual correction.

Complex

Rule-breaking
INNOVATIONS

Challenging convention with every tick. Our innovations redefine what a timepiece can be — where avant-garde design meets cutting-edge mechanics. We don’t just push boundaries. We erase them.

For over a century, Orologio has been at the forefront of luxury watchmaking, crafting timepieces that embody precision, elegance, and innovation. Our commitment to excellence has defined every generation, making each watch not just a keeper of time, but a symbol of enduring quality and timeless design.

item.title: The Timeless Appeal of Mechanical Watches
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded: Mechanical watches have captivated collectors for centuries. It's not just about telling time — it's about appreciating precision engineering, history, and artistry. In this post, we explore why mechanical watches continue to hold their value, and why every watch lover should own at least one.
item.excerpt:encoded: In a world dominated by smart devices, mechanical watches remain a symbol of craftsmanship and heritage.

item.title: Home v2
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Timeless Elegance

Experience the art of watchmaking
Shop now Contact

“Designing a watch is like sculpting time itself— every detail must honor both the fleeting and the eternal. ”

Founder & Watchmaker
Discover

Our WATCHES

  • ChronoCraft Forge

    Quartz, Ø 44mm, Black

    $990.00 View cart

  • ChronoCraft Eclipse

    Quartz Chronograph, Ø 45mm, Silver

    $870.00 View cart

  • ChronoCraft Legacy

    Automatic, Ø 44mm, Black

    $890.00 View cart

  • Precision Zenith

    Automatic, Ø 40mm, Silver

    $670.00 View cart

CRAFTED for
THOSE who VALUE
every MOMENT

Our

Craftmanship

At Orologio, every watch is a testament to the art of precision. Our master artisans combine traditional techniques with modern innovation to create timepieces that embody elegance and durability. Each detail is meticulously crafted, ensuring that every second is a masterpiece.

Savoir-faire
Our

Heritage

Orologio’s legacy is built on a deep respect for the art of watchmaking. With roots tracing back to the traditions of Swiss horology, we blend timeless craftsmanship with modern innovation. Each timepiece reflects our commitment to preserving the past while shaping the future of luxury watches.

Our history

Elegance in MOTION

Book an appointment Orologio Timepieces Ltd., 15 Rue de la Horlogerie, Geneva, Switzerland, 1204
Timeless Design Rich Heritage Refined Artistry
Explore

The Journal

How to Start Your First Watch Collection (Without Breaking the Bank)

Passion first. Price tag second. Great collections aren’t about how much you spend — they’re about what every piece means to you.

Watch Movements Explained: Quartz and Automatic

The heart of your watch matters more than you think — what’s inside that truly keeps your story ticking.

Vintage vs. Modern Watches — Which One Fits Your Style?

Old soul or modern minimalist? Let’s find out — every watch says something about who you are.

Where

Precision meets
ARTISTRY

Velocita Strada is a masterpiece of precision and style, blending timeless craftsmanship with modern innovation. Featuring sleek lines, a bold dial, and exceptional durability, it’s designed for those who move confidently between worlds — from day to night, and beyond.

ARTISTRY

Velocita Corsa is a masterpiece of precision and style, blending timeless craftsmanship with modern innovation. Featuring sleek lines, a bold dial, and exceptional durability, it’s designed for those who move confidently between worlds — from day to night, and beyond.

item.title: Precision Nova
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Where

Precision meets
ARTISTRY

Precision Nova is a masterpiece of precision and style, blending timeless craftsmanship with modern innovation. Featuring sleek lines, a bold dial, and exceptional durability, it’s designed for those who move confidently between worlds — from day to night, and beyond.

  • Download instruction manual
  • How to use the watch
  • Instructions manual
Read

The SPECS

Case

Shape

Round

Dimension

Ø 40.00 mm

Water Resistance

Water-resistant to 3 bar

Lug distance

21mm

Lug-to-lug

46.80 mm

Thickness

9.35 mm

Dial & Hands

Dial color

Silver

Hands

Pink hands

Hour markers

Engraved Arabic numerals

Movement & Functions

Movement Type

Automatic

Functions

Hours, minutes, seconds

Caliber

L888

Strap

Material

Alligator strap

Color

Brown

Buckle

With triple safety folding clasp and push-piece opening mechanism

Where

Precision meets
ARTISTRY

Precision Meridian is a masterpiece of precision and style, blending timeless craftsmanship with modern innovation. Featuring sleek lines, a bold dial, and exceptional durability, it’s designed for those who move confidently between worlds — from day to night, and beyond.

Dial & Hands

Dial color

Silver

Hands

Pink hands

Hour markers

Engraved Arabic numerals

Movement Type

Automatic

Caliber

L888

Strap

Material

Alligator strap

Color

Brown

Buckle

With triple safety folding clasp and push-piece opening mechanism

item.title: ChronoCraft Legacy
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Where

Precision meets
ARTISTRY

ChronoCraft Legacy is a masterpiece of precision and style, blending timeless craftsmanship with modern innovation. Featuring sleek lines, a bold dial, and exceptional durability, it’s designed for those who move confidently between worlds — from day to night, and beyond.

  • Download instruction manual
  • How to use the watch
  • Instructions manual
Read

The SPECS

Case

Shape

Round

Dimension

Ø 40.00 mm

Water Resistance

Water-resistant to 3 bar

Lug distance

21mm

Lug-to-lug

46.80 mm

Thickness

9.35 mm

Dial & Hands

Dial color

Silver

Hands

Pink hands

Hour markers

Engraved Arabic numerals

Movement & Functions

Movement Type

Automatic

Functions

Hours, minutes, seconds

Caliber

L888

Strap

Material

Alligator strap

Color

Brown

Buckle

With triple safety folding clasp and push-piece opening mechanism

item.title: ChronoCraft Eclipse
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Where

Precision meets ARTISTRY

ChronoCraft Eclipse is a masterpiece of precision and style, blending timeless craftsmanship with modern innovation. Featuring sleek lines, a bold dial, and exceptional durability, it’s designed for those who move confidently between worlds — from day to night, and beyond.

  • Download instruction manual
  • How to use the watch
  • Instructions manual
Read

The SPECS

Case

Shape
Round
Dimension
Ø 40.00 mm
Water Resistance
Water-resistant to 3 bar
Lug distance
21mm
Lug-to-lug
46.80 mm
Thickness
9.35 mm

Dial & Hands

Dial color
Silver
Hands
Pink hands
Hour markers
Engraved Arabic numerals

Movement & Functions

Movement Type
Automatic
Functions
Hours, minutes, seconds
Caliber
L888

Strap

Material
Alligator strap
Color
Brown
Buckle
With triple safety folding clasp and push-piece opening mechanism

item.title: Top 5 Dive Watches for Everyday Wear
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded: Dive watches are more versatile than ever. Whether you’re heading to a meeting or the beach, these rugged timepieces combine style with performance. Our top picks include classics like the Rolex Submariner, Omega Seamaster, and affordable options like the Seiko SKX007.
item.excerpt:encoded: Built for the depths, perfect for daily life — it’s ready for whatever your everyday adventure looks like.

item.title: Vintage vs. Modern Watches — Which One Fits Your Style?
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded: Vintage watches carry stories and patina that new models simply can’t replicate. But modern watches offer cutting-edge materials and reliability. This post breaks down the pros and cons of vintage vs. modern pieces, helping you choose what’s right for your collection.
item.excerpt:encoded: Old soul or modern minimalist? Let’s find out — every watch says something about who you are.

item.title: Watch Movements Explained: Quartz and Automatic
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded: Ever wonder what makes your watch tick? We break down the differences between quartz, automatic, and manual wind movements. Learn how each works, their pros and cons, and why some collectors swear by traditional mechanical craftsmanship over battery-powered accuracy.
item.excerpt:encoded: The heart of your watch matters more than you think — what’s inside that truly keeps your story ticking.

item.title: How to Start Your First Watch Collection (Without Breaking the Bank)
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded: Starting a watch collection doesn’t have to cost a fortune. From vintage gems to modern microbrands, we share tips on how to build a meaningful collection, avoid rookie mistakes, and find watches you’ll actually love to wear.
item.excerpt:encoded: Passion first. Price tag second. Great collections aren’t about how much you spend — they’re about what every piece means to you.
